ruleDefinitions.name: Microsoft IIS Connection Strings Decryption
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects use of aspnet_regiis to decrypt Microsoft IIS connection strings. An attacker with Microsoft IIS web server access via a webshell or alike can decrypt and dump any hardcoded connection strings, such as the MSSQL service account password using aspnet_regiis command.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\aspnet\\_regiis\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "aspnet\_regiis\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*connectionStrings.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-pdf.*")))
